items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Now listen, Pete Lala's name, he was not Pete Lala. It was Pete Sika Sika.

ctx.x: Do you know anything about the relationship between John Lala and Pete Lala? Were they?

No, no relation. There were no relations. No. Now listen, Pete Lala's name, he was not Pete Lala. It was Pete Sika Sika. But he just gave him that name, Pete Lala. Pete Lala, I think he was a relative of the trumpet player. Who? Johnny Lala was it?
Well, there's several of them. There's three Mike Lala's. I know three Mike Lala's. Tell about Tom Anderson. Tell now, tell us about Tom Anderson. What's that for you? Well...

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: I never played for Pete Lala, no.

ctx.x: I never played for Pete Lala, no.
He had a better job than Pete Lala's job, this guy. What about that one?

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-28
items.q: You were talking the other night about the Coom Shouters, you called them, up at, was that at Pete Lala's?

ctx.x: They used to holler, hey now. Remember, hey now? We would be full of wine and things, you know. Dance in the street and everything. They'd probably do a naked dance in the street. They'd never had on nothing. Have a sandwich in the street, actually. That's the truth. Huh? That's the truth. They'll have a sandwich in the street, huh? Sure. Sure. You were talking the other night about the Coom Shouters, you called them, up at, was that at Pete Lala's? You mentioned this Thacker, was that her name again? Yeah. and…
